description: Non-material amendment to approved permission 1759/23: Alteration to party wall depths to comply with Building Regulations Part L, with resulting extension to the footprint of the building to the rear by 777.5mm. Alteration to depth of service risers and smoke ducts to achieve minimum 850mm required within Building Regulations Part B for natural smoke shafts. Adjustments to layouts of homes to comply with nationally described space standards, Building Regulations Part M, and design guidance. Door, window, and building line positions amended to align with unit layouts. A window omitted to two kitchens where these clashed with kitchen counters and cupboards. Brick piers added to rear south corner balcony. Introduction of a substation at ground floor level to meet the requirements of UKPN and window omitted at ground floor. (Summary).
site_name: Development At Evergreen Field Former 28 And 30
decision_conditions:
Noise emitted from any new substation equipment shall be designed to a level at least 5 dB below the representative existing background noise level when assessed in accordance with BS 4142: 2014 + A1: 2019 at a position 1 m from the window (or a calculation thereof) to the nearest noise sensitive premises (i.e. Plant LAr,T = -5 dB LA90,T) by a Suitably Qualified Acoustician. This criterion applies to the total contribution of noise from the substation that may run during any particular period. The commissioning protocol shall be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority in advance of testing and the results shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the relevant part of the scheme being tested and occupied.

Reason: In order to ensure that the residential accommodation and amenity areas to be provided are suitably protected from any external source of disturbance, and to accord with Policies LP24 and LP26 of the Council’s Local Plan.
